title: fs-lint configuration
description: Rules for proposed file and folder paths, independent of language. The CLI also checks duplicate keys and byte limits: 1048576 bytes per config, 4096 bytes per pattern, and 262144 total pattern bytes.

$schema.description: Schema location for editors and agents. fs-lint accepts this metadata without loading it.

version.description: Configuration format version. Use the integer 1.

counterparts.description: One-way file mappings. Each from and to pattern contains exactly one ** capture. Matching paths require an existing target file.

newFiles.description: Policy for added files and rename destinations. Paths are relative to the repository.

default.description: Decision when no pattern matches. Omission means deny.

allow.description: Ordered path globs. The last matching pattern wins; a leading ! denies. Match the full path with *, **, ?, and {a,b}. **/ matches zero or more directories. Both slash styles are path separators.
